subject: design/codegate-v1
statement: the prior verdict is the only state (`#D-4`, `#ALT-8`). An `--incremental` invocation reads the workspace's prior verdict; it qualifies as state only when **every DINV-1 binding except the head revision matches** — resolved diff base, manifest hash, baseline hash, codegate version, git version — and it parses (DINV-8); otherwise the run is full. When it qualifies, the re-run set is: the previously-failed rung first (FR-3), **plus every rung not recorded pass** (unreached and errored rungs re-run — the record's rule, restored), **plus every rung whose input set changed** under `git diff <prior head sha>`. Only prior passes with unchanged inputs carry forward, marked `carried-from <run id>`.
